name: farmerchat-web-site
description: Builds the v2 web SDK + widget and serves the hosted showcase (landing, web app, widget demo, guide) (Railway service root = versions/v2, deployed from GitHub).

scripts.build: npm --prefix web/packages/farmerchat-web ci && npm --prefix web/packages/farmerchat-web run build && npm --prefix web/widget ci && npm --prefix web/widget run build && npm --prefix web/demo-app ci && npm --prefix web/demo-app run build
